title: Sadie Sink Is About to Get Stuck in a Love Triangle—On TV!
summary: Ever finished college and thought, 'Now what?' That's the messy, funny, and sometimes confusing question at the heart of a new TV show starring Sadie Sink. You might know her as Max from Stranger Things, but soon she'll play a character caught in a love triangle—when three people have romantic feelings that get all tangled up. The show is called 'The Marriage Plot,' and it's based on a popular book by Jeffrey Eugenides. It follows three friends who just graduated from college and have to figure out big stuff like who they love, what kind of grown-ups they want to be, and how to not mess everything up. The series is being made by FX and will stream on Hulu. The writer is Will Arbery, who worked on the hit show Succession, and the director is Hiro Murai, who helped make Atlanta and the famous 'This Is America' music video. Sadie Sink isn't just acting in it—she's also an executive producer, which means she helps make big decisions about the show. She's been super busy: after Stranger Things, she starred in the movie The Whale, performed on Broadway, and even appeared in a Taylor Swift short film. Next, she'll be in a new Spider-Man movie! So if you like stories about friendship, romance, and the chaos of being young, keep an eye out for 'The Marriage Plot.' It might just be your next favorite show.
why_it_matters: This show can help you understand that everyone faces tough choices about friends, love, and what to do next, even after they grow up.
